sqlQueryPattern: Single joined query joining search_plan_candidates -> canonical_opportunities -> opportunity_versions -> materialized_evaluations -> decisions
clientRefetchBehavior: When pill category (e.g. TRANSFORMATION) is selected, useEffect triggers getOpportunitiesFn({ categoryId }), causing a client-server roundtrip to fetch filtered candidates.
optimizationRecommendation: Category filtering can be performed in-memory on client or cached per scope.
